source_schedule: 0 6 * * 0 (crontab) plus the three per-job crontab lines it duplicates
target_objects: Databricks job ow_tp_custbill (Terraform resource databricks_job.ow_tp_custbill in infrastructure/terraform-databricks/)
target_code_path: infrastructure/terraform-databricks/job_custbill.tf (edit the parent's shell: task parameters, trigger, notifications) + databricks/custbill_workflow/ (job JSON snapshot + verification script)
golden_baseline_location: Regenerated: `RUN_ALL_SLEEP=0 make legacy-etl-run JOB=run_all` under `OTTERWORKS_LEGACY_ROOT=/home/ubuntu/otterworks-legacy-<ns>` via scripts/tp-run-deterministic.sh (TP_FAKETIME='2026-09-01 02:10:00'). Baseline = the U6/U7/U8 baselines produced by that single chained run (incoming bytes, 100 PSV rows, 6-row CSV).

behaviour.tasks: ingest → parse → finance, `depends_on` chain, each a serverless notebook task receiving job parameter `ns` (and finance `report_date`).
behaviour.concurrency: max_concurrent_runs = 1 (replaces the three never-removed lock files and the overlapping crontab lines).
behaviour.trigger: file_arrival on /Volumes/ow_tp/bronze/landing/<ns>/incoming/ if the workspace supports it for a UC volume (verified in wave 0 by `custbill.py verify-trigger`), else cron `0 */15 * * * ?`. Both PAUSED until STOP E; the Sunday run_all becomes a manual `Run now` of the same job — no separate code.
behaviour.failure_policy: retries=2 per task with 5-minute backoff; a task failure fails the run and stops downstream tasks (no partial finance on partial parse — replaces sleep 600); e-mail notification on failure to finance_recipients.
behaviour.parameters: ns (required, validated ^[a-z0-9-]{1,32}$), report_date (optional ISO date, default UTC today).

encoding_policy.byte_transparency: n/a — asserted by the three task units

malformed_record_policy.details: Orchestration passes no data; any task exception fails the run. A missing/invalid `ns` parameter fails before the first task runs.

empty_input_semantics.details: Run with no files: ingest no-op, parse no-op, finance rewrites the namespace's (empty or unchanged) gold — run SUCCEEDS, duration under 5 minutes on serverless.

planted_anomalies.description: Force the parse task to fail (bad `ns`/injected exception in a test run on the child's ns) → finance task is SKIPPED and the run is FAILED; no gold rows written for that run.
Trigger two runs back-to-back → the second is QUEUED/SKIPPED per max_concurrent_runs=1, never concurrent (Jobs API run list shows no overlap).

acceptance_checks.description: Jobs API `get`: tasks == [ingest, parse, finance] with depends_on chain; max_concurrent_runs == 1; schedule/trigger pause_status == PAUSED; notifications carry finance_recipients; no cluster spec (serverless).
One end-to-end `run-job --wait` on the child's ns from a fresh landing reproduces U6-a/b, U7-a/b/c and U8-a/b verdicts via the recon harness (run_mode live on that ns).
downstream_on_partial_upstream and overlapping_runs anomalies observed as described (run states captured in the recon report evidence).
Idempotency: second end-to-end run with no new files → SUCCESS, 0 new bronze/silver rows, identical gold and CSV bytes (T9).

deficiencies_retired: sleep 600 dependency management → task DAG with failure propagation
overlapping cron lines / self-overlap → single job, max_concurrent_runs=1
2>/dev/null || true on every stage → failures fail the run and notify
Sunday full-chain duplicate schedule → same job, manual run

run_mode_budget.child: own ns slice `<unit>-w3` (job runs with ns=custbill-workflow-w3); report run_mode=live with that namespace; never NS=demo; never edits schedule pause_status

unverified_paths_expected: file_arrival trigger in production (customer landing mechanism, R4)
